papers.title_en: MedSTP: Preserving Subspace and Transition Evidence for Medical VQA Token Pruning
papers.authors: Mengchen Fan, Qizhen Lan, Xi Xiao, Lin Zhao, Liang He, Tianyang Wang, Xiaoqian Jiang, Pulin Che, Baocheng Geng
papers.evidence: 面向医疗 VQA 的保留子空间证据的免训练视觉 token 剪枝
papers.tldr: 医疗视觉问答需将长视觉 token 序列送入语言模型，剪枝虽能降本，却可能丢失诊断依赖的局部边界与纹理证据。MedSTP 将无训练预解码剪枝建模为子空间稳定证据保持：在主成分空间估计每个 token 的谱支持，构建紧凑表示子空间，并用有界 token 网格转移先验增强边界和纹理敏感 token。在 SLAKE、OmniMedVQA 与 RadImageNet-VQA 上，基于 Lingshu-7B 和 Qwen3-VL-8B 的闭集与开集评估均取得稳定表现。
papers.abstract_en: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) for visual question answering (VQA) often pass long visual-token sequences to the language model, making visual-token pruning attractive but risky for medical images, where answers may depend on localized boundary and texture evidence. We study training free pre-decoding pruning and treat pruning as a subspace stable evidence preservation problem. The retained tokens should remain close to the dominant visual evidence subspace induced by the full token set. To this end, we propose \emph{Subspace-Transition Token Pruning} (\method{}), which estimates each token's spectral support from principal component space and constructs a compact representation subspace. To better reflect medical image structure, \method{} further uses a bounded token-grid transition prior to promote boundary and texture sensitive tokens. We evaluate \method{} on the closed-ended SLAKE and OmniMedVQA benchmarks and on RadImageNet-VQA, which provides both closed-ended and open-ended evaluations, using Lingshu-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B backbones. \method{} delivers consistently strong performance on both the closed-ended and open-ended RadImageNet-VQA evaluations. These results show that \method{} is an effective training free pruning framework for medical domain VQA.

papers.title_en: ProQuant: Preserving Expert Quality over Quantity in Ultra-Low-Bit Quantization of Mixture-of-Experts Models
papers.authors: Jiaqi Chen, Xianglong Yan, Chengzhu Bao, Xie Chen, Yulun Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向MoE大语言模型的权重仅后训练量化
papers.tldr: 混合专家大模型虽靠稀疏激活降低计算，但存储开销仍高；现有混合精度PTQ在极低比特预算下易低估跨层传播的非线性量化误差，并可能因路由微调导致路由漂移。ProQuant是面向MoE的权重-only PTQ框架：PoP联合优化专家剪枝与位宽分配，让高精度专家替代严重退化专家；RoCo通过数学等价变换微调RMSNorm，补偿量化误差并降低路由漂移。多种生成任务实验表明其优于现有方法，在超低比特下更好保留专家质量与预算利用率。
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models reduce computation through sparse activation but still incur substantial storage costs. Mixed-precision post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces these costs by quantizing different model components at different bit widths, but existing methods often struggle to preserve generation quality under tight bit budgets. We identify two key challenges: (1) nonlinear quantization errors at extremely low precision are underestimated when cross-layer propagation is ignored; (2) direct router fine-tuning may cause routing drift, and calibration gains may not generalize to downstream tasks. To address these issues, we propose ProQuant, a weight-only PTQ framework for MoE models. Prune-or-Prioritize Mixed-Precision Allocation (PoP) jointly optimizes expert pruning and bit-width assignment. It allows higher-precision experts to substitute for severely degraded ones while improving bit-budget utilization. Routing-Consistent RMSNorm Finetune (RoCo) adapts expert input representations through mathematically equivalent transformations. It compensates for quantization errors to reduce routing drift. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ProQuant outperforms existing methods across diverse generative tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/ThrowBug/ProQuant.git.

papers.authors: Bavesh Balaji, Pranav Gopinath, Pouya Sadeghi, Sirisha Rambhatla
papers.evidence: 按查询自适应分配视觉令牌预算以减少视觉令牌数
papers.tldr: 现有视觉与视觉语言模型大多与查询无关地编码图像，并为每个输入分配固定的视觉 token 预算，造成冗余。QART 是一个与主干网络无关的模块，它以冻结编码器特征为起点，循环构建紧凑表示，并依据查询相关视觉支撑区域的重建质量决定何时停止分配 token，使表示既可被查询引导又能自适应预算。在 Visual7W 和 VQAv2 上，QART 仅用约 29 个视觉 token 就取得 81.96% 和 76.37% 的准确率，token 数较稠密 VLM 输入减少 20-25 倍。该工作表明视觉表示的内容与容量都不必固定，可按查询需求动态调整。
papers.abstract_en: Visual information worth extracting from an image and the token budget it warrants depend on the text query. Yet modern vision and vision-language models largely encode images independently of the query and allocate a fixed visual token budget to every input. We introduce the Query-Adaptive Recurrent Tokenizer (QART), a backbone-agnostic module that makes visual representations both query-steerable and budget-adaptive. QART steers the visual representation toward query-relevant evidence while adapting its token budget to the amount of information required. Its key principle is simple. Additional tokens are allocated until the visual features relevant to the query are represented with sufficient fidelity. Starting from frozen encoder features, QART recurrently constructs a compact representation and uses reconstruction quality over the query-relevant visual support to control token allocation. On Visual7W and VQAv2, QART achieves 81.96% and 76.37% accuracy using only about 29 visual tokens, reducing token counts by 20-25x relative to dense VLM inputs. It further reaches 92.0% P@1 on CORE and 36.3% PR-AUC on PODS, outperforming SteerViT on PODS by 8.4%. Together, these results show that visual representations need not be fixed in either content or capacity and can instead adapt to what each query requires.

papers.title_en: GazeLens for Efficient Egocentric Video Question Answering with Simple Gaze-Driven Adaptive Token Reduction
papers.authors: Trong-Thang Pham, Anh Nguyen, Hien Van Nguyen, Ngan Le
papers.evidence: 视觉语言模型中注视与问题引导的视觉令牌削减
papers.tldr: 智能眼镜的第一视角视频问答需在有限算力下保留关键证据，但冗余帧挤占视觉预算，过度压缩又会丢失细节。GazeLens按HOG变化与清晰度选帧，用高斯池化生成注视聚焦与互补摘要，经轻量门控按问题融合为主token，并保留全局场景token，每帧仅两个token。在StreamGaze上，其宏/微准确率超过全网格与token缩减基线，输入FLOPs低于共享骨干的token缩减基线。该工作为可穿戴设备提供了简单有效的注视驱动token缩减方案。
papers.abstract_en: Smart glasses can help users understand their activities and surroundings, but small vision-language models must preserve useful evidence within limited computation. This is difficult because redundant frames consume the visual budget, while aggressive spatial compression can discard relevant details. Although gaze identifies the wearer's focus, the question may require evidence from the surrounding scene. To address these constraints, we propose GazeLens, which combines frame selection with gaze- and question-guided token reduction. First, HOG transitions and image sharpness select frames before visual encoding. For each selected frame, Gaussian pooling then forms gaze-focused and complementary summaries. Because their relevance depends on the question, a lightweight gate blends them into a primary token. Together with a global scene token, this retains both focused and contextual summaries within two tokens per frame. On StreamGaze, GazeLens achieves higher macro and micro accuracy than the evaluated full-grid and token-reduction baselines, with lower input-forward FLOPs than the shared-backbone token-reduction baselines.

papers.title_en: Multi-Scale Latent Temporal Compression Attention and Video-Text Cross Attention Fusion for Video Action Detection
papers.evidence: 多尺度时序压缩注意力减少冗余帧令牌用于视频动作检测
papers.tldr: 视频动作检测需建模连续视频流的时间依赖，但现有深度网络受帧信息冗余、全局与局部特征难平衡及视觉文本融合不足制约。本文提出多尺度潜在时间压缩注意力模块，将连续时序聚合为多尺度特征并降低冗余，同时设计视频-文本交叉注意力融合模块，在潜在与标准特征层面实现细粒度语义对齐。多个视频识别基准实验显示其性能优于现有方法，验证了有效性与泛化能力。
papers.abstract_en: In video action detection, modeling the temporal dependencies in continuous video streams is crucial. Previous methods based on deep neural networks can perform frame-level video recognition tasks. However, these methods struggle to model dynamic temporal patterns, facing challenges such as redundant frame information, difficulty balancing global and local features, and insufficient fusion of visual and textual features. To address these issues, we propose a video temporal attention module based on the Multi-Scale Latent Temporal Compression Attention, which aggregates continuous temporal sequences into feature representations across diverse temporal scales while efficiently reducing redundancy. We also introduce a Video-Text Cross Attention Fusion module that leverages cross-attention at both latent and standard feature levels, achieving fine-grained fusion between video and textual features to enhance semantic alignment and feature interaction. Experimental results across multiple video recognition benchmarks demonstrate that our proposed methods achieve superior performance compared to existing methods, validating the effectiveness and generalization capability.

papers.title_en: N-Gram Memories at Two Bits: Quantizing Lookup Tables in Large Language Models
papers.authors: Donghoon Han, Minseop Jung, Dong Woo Kwak, SeungJae Lee, Junhoo Lee
papers.evidence: 面向大模型查找表的二比特量化与共享重建
papers.tldr: 条件记忆通过查表扩展语言模型容量，但完整嵌入表必须始终可用。作者提出 Conditional Program，以短码、局部缩放和全表共享重构程序，仅重建输入请求的行，并用高斯网格实现。两比特编码使输出 KL 较 2-bit 最近舍入降低 41–63%，在三个 n-gram 记忆族上共享网格优于拟合码本和低秩残差变体。在 DeepSeek 上表存储由 203GB 降至 51GB，为 GPU 保留更大工作负载空间。
papers.abstract_en: Conditional memory expands language-model capacity through selective lookup, but the full embedding table must remain available for every possible input. We introduce Conditional Program (CP), a compressed representation that reconstructs only the rows an input requests. CP represents each row by a short code and a local scale, with a reconstruction program shared across the table. We instantiate this representation with a Gaussian trellis, norm restoration and independently decodable row records. CP's two-bit code lowers output KL by 41--63\% relative to 2-bit round-to-nearest. Analysis across three trained n-gram memory families shows that Gaussian-like coordinate statistics coexist with learned relationships among rows; at matched storage budgets, the shared trellis outperforms the fitted codebooks and low-rank residual variants we test. For DeepSeek, it reduces table storage from 203GB to 51GB, leaving room for larger workloads when the table is kept on GPU.

papers.title_en: Memory as Weights: Internalizing Long-Term History for Streaming Videos
papers.authors: Zhuoming Liu, Jinhong Lin, Lin Zhang, Yiwu Zhong, Yin Li
papers.evidence: 将流式视频历史固化进固定大小LoRA权重以实现内存高效记忆
papers.tldr: 流式视觉语言模型需持续整合历史并响应当前观测，但现有记忆机制把历史压缩、检索或缓存后重新放入上下文，使历史与当前输入争夺有限上下文。MaLoW将历史内化为可演化轻量参数，用循环HyperNetwork把视频观测增量写入固定大小LoRA权重，让历史由权重承载、当前观测仍作输入。在三大流式视频基准上表现强劲，OVO-Bench backward分片较先前方法提升3.9%至11.8%，并泛化到视觉-语言-动作模型。
papers.abstract_en: Streaming vision-language models (VLMs) must continuously integrate information from the past while remaining responsive to current observations and user queries. Existing memory mechanisms typically compress, retrieve, or cache historical observations and reintroduce them into the input context, forcing historical memory and current observations to compete for limited context. We propose MaLoW, a streaming memory framework that instead internalizes historical context into evolving lightweight parameter updates. MaLoW uses a recurrent HyperNetwork to incrementally consolidate incoming video observations into fixed-size LoRA weights, allowing historical information to be carried forward without revisiting the full video stream. In doing so, MaLoW represents history as weights, while keeping the current observation as input. To support training, we further construct MaLoW-Instruct, a large-scale streaming video dataset containing 381K question-answer pairs over 56K videos. We conduct extensive experiments to demonstrate that MaLoW achieves strong performance on OVO-Bench, StreamingBench, and StreamArena. On the backward split of OVO-Bench, MaLoW outperforms prior memory approaches by 3.9% to 11.8% across different video backbones while incurring only modest latency overhead. Beyond streaming video understanding, MaLoW also generalizes to vision-language-action models, improving the action success rate on Simpler WidowX by 9.3%.

papers.title_en: Retrofitting Recurrent Vision-Language Models from Pretrained Backbones
papers.authors: Madhav Iyengar, Andreas Geiger, Hilde Kühne
papers.evidence: 层剪枝加深度循环以压缩视觉语言模型参数规模
papers.tldr: 针对预训练视觉语言模型参数冗余问题，本文把深度循环改造到VLM语言主干：剪枝部分层并循环剩余层，用线性适配器融合前层表示。为恢复性能，设计语言预训练、投影器对齐和视觉指令微调三阶段训练，并在首尾阶段蒸馏原模型。在TinyLLaVA-1.4B上，改造模型语言参数少23.3%仍优于同数据恢复的未剪枝基线，推理基准提升且基础理解持平。
papers.abstract_en: Recent work shows that depth recurrence can be retrofitted into pretrained language models. In this work, we adapt this paradigm for visual understanding, using depth recurrence to reduce the parameter footprint of a pretrained vision-language model (VLM). To this end, we prune layers from the language backbone of the VLM and loop over a subset of the remaining layers. At each step of the loop, a linear adapter merges the block's output with the token representations from the preceding layers and projects the fused representation back into the block. As the pruning impacts the original model performance, we propose a three-stage recovery training: first, we leverage a language-only pretraining to recover the performance of the language backbone, followed by an alignment of the vision-language projector, and a full fine-tuning of the model via visual instruction tuning. In the first and the last stage, we distill the outputs of the pretrained non-recurrent model into the recurrent model, which further improves the recovery. We evaluate the proposed approach on the TinyLLaVA-1.4B backbone without introducing any new vision-language data during retrofitting. Our experiments demonstrate that the retrofitted recurrent model outperforms the unpruned baseline trained with the same recovery data while storing 23.3% fewer language parameters. We further show that the proposed retrofitting recurrence outperforms the setup of converting a recurrent LM into a VLM on the same data. Additionally, our ablations show how design choices, such as the adapter between recurrences and a larger recurrent block, lead to the improved performance of our approach. Finally, we find that our proposed model gains on reasoning-oriented benchmarks, whereas its performance on basic visual understanding benchmarks remains on par with the baseline.

papers.title_en: Reusing Calibration Gains across Model Representations
papers.evidence: 将校准增益迁移到GPTQ INT3模型的量化尺度上
papers.tldr: 尺度校准通常只针对同一预训练模型的一种表示学习更新。该工作提取分组正增益，并在不优化接收端的情况下移植到另一表示的权重或原生量化尺度中，且保持量化整数码、零点与存储布局。Qwen3-1.7B浮点/GPTQ INT3双向迁移保留76.9%–90.5%的文本损失改善；Llama-3.2-3B交叉安装保留98.6%–99.3%收益。结果表明校准增益可跨表示复用，但接收端专属训练仍有剩余价值。
papers.abstract_en: Scale calibration learns an update for one model representation. We study how much of that update can be reused by another representation of the same pretrained model. Our transfer procedure extracts positive group-wise gains and installs them in the recipient's weights or native quantization scales without recipient-side optimization. On a quantized recipient, it preserves integer codes, zero points and storage layout. For a Qwen3-1.7B floating-point/GPTQ INT3 pair, bidirectional transfer retains 76.9-90.5% of the text-loss improvement from recipient-specific calibration on fresh WikiText and C4 cohorts excluded from project development. Shuffling the same gain values within each projection worsens both recipients, showing that their learned group assignment matters after transfer. A Llama-3.2-3B control keeps the initial native tensors at all four calibrated projections identical and changes nine projections elsewhere. Cross-installation retains 98.6-99.3% of the text-calibration benefit, alongside a small, resolved preference for each recipient's own gain. These results quantify both the adaptation carried by a reusable calibration update and the remaining benefit of recipient-specific training.

papers.title_en: MaskMerge: Structure-aware Token Merging for Efficient Instance Segmentation
papers.authors: Bavesh Balaji, Letian Jiang, Alexander Wong, David Clausi, Sirisha Rambhatla
papers.evidence: 结构感知的视觉令牌合并以减少冗余令牌加速视觉Transformer
papers.tldr: 现有 token 合并方法多依赖特征相似度判断冗余 token，在实例分割中，同类相邻实例外观高度相似，容易发生跨实例 token 融合并破坏实例边界。MaskMerge 将粗粒度中间掩码预测引入合并约束，使基于特征的 token 合并遵循实例结构，从而减少错误融合并保留边界。在 PanNuke 与 iSAID 上，相较 ALGM，mAP 分别由 30.1 提升至 32.1、由 33.1 提升至 36.2，计算量由 229 降至 153 GFLOPs、由 198 降至 182 GFLOPs，并分别加速 1.18 倍与 1.23 倍。该实例感知合并策略在外观相似场景中实现更高效压缩，并可迁移至 MAE 预训练骨干。
papers.abstract_en: Token merging improves the efficiency of Vision Transformers by combining redundant tokens, but existing methods largely rely on feature similarity to determine which tokens to merge. This criterion is effective for semantic segmentation, yet can fail in instance segmentation, where adjacent objects of the same class often have highly similar features. We identify this failure mode as cross-instance token fusion. We introduce MaskMerge, an instance-aware token merging method that uses coarse intermediate mask predictions to constrain feature-based merging and preserve instance boundaries. We evaluate MaskMerge on two diverse instance segmentation domains characterized by high inter-instance visual similarity: PanNuke and iSAID. Against the SOTA token merging method ALGM, MaskMerge improves mAP from 30.1 to 32.1 on PanNuke while reducing computation from 229 to 153 GFLOPs and running 1.18x faster, and from 33.1 to 36.2 on iSAID while reducing computation from 198 to 182 GFLOPs and running 1.23x faster. Additionally, we also test it on Cityscapes and match ALGM's performance while using fewer FLOPs. The gains also transfer to an MAE pretrained backbone, demonstrating that instance-aware merging enables more aggressive compression when appearance similarity alone cannot reliably preserve object identity.

papers.title_en: E8-QAT: Efficient 2-Bit Quantization-Aware Training with Implicit Lattice Codebooks
papers.authors: Xinyu Lei, Hong Huang, Jiebin Zhang, Hongyu Li, Jinlong Song, Decheng Wu, Guanghua Yu, Jianchen Zhu, Sujian Li
papers.evidence: 面向大语言模型的二比特量化感知训练与格码本
papers.tldr: 低比特量化可显著压缩大模型显存，但兼顾精度与训练效率仍是难点。E8-QAT 将 E8 格作为隐式八维码本，通过算术投影联合量化权重组，训练前向无需存储或搜索显式码本。它在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上四项任务平均分追平全精度，并较 SOTA 在 IFEval、LiveCodeBench 分别提升 2.03% 和 1.51%。该方法还将峰值显存降低 80%，支持 4 倍批大小，解码吞吐达 BF16 的 1.97 倍。
papers.abstract_en: Low-bit quantization reduces the memory footprint of large language models, but preserving accuracy with efficient training remains challenging. Scalar quantization encodes weights independently, while explicit-codebook vector quantization introduces costly search during training. We propose E8-QAT, a 2-bit quantization-aware training framework that uses the $E_8$ lattice as an implicit eight-dimensional codebook. It jointly quantizes weight groups through arithmetic projection without storing or searching an explicit codebook during the training forward pass. A 2-bit core encoding and sparse extension preserve the selected lattice points exactly, adding less than 0.1\% to core index storage. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, E8-QAT matches the performance of the full-precision model in terms of the average score across the four tasks. E8-QAT improves over the state-of-the-art baseline by 2.03\% on IFEval and by 1.51\% on LiveCodeBench, under the same data, schedule, and bit width. The 2-bit representation reduces peak memory by 80\% and supports a $4\times$ larger batch. At each representation's largest feasible batch, E8-QAT reaches $1.97\times$ the decoding throughput of BF16.

papers.title_en: Offline Makes Online Better: Calibrated Cache Compression for Video Generation
papers.authors: Zhen Wang, Ning Lai, Qingtao Yu
papers.evidence: 通过令牌合并聚类时间冗余视频令牌以压缩缓存
papers.tldr: 自回归视频生成中，token merging 可压缩 KV-cache，但现有方法对所有层和注意力头采用统一合并比例，忽略敏感度差异。论文提出 CALM：离线校准各层头对合并的风险，在线按缓存预算用动态规划分配合并比例。在三个模型上，同等内存下 LPIPS 较原视频降低约21%，视频质量分数更高。该工作把离线校准与在线压缩结合，为缓存压缩提供更精细的层头分配方案。
papers.abstract_en: Token merging is an effective approach to reducing KV-cache memory consumption in autoregressive video generation by clustering temporally redundant tokens and retaining only a small set of representatives. Existing methods, however, typically apply a uniform merging ratio across all attention layers and heads. We observe that different layers and heads exhibit substantially different yet jointly correlated sensitivities to token merging, and that these sensitivity patterns remain consistent across prompts. Based on this observation, we introduce CALM, a Calibrated Allocation for Layer-Head Merging that uses offline calibration to improve online cache compression. Exhaustively evaluating all possible layer-head allocations is prohibitively expensive. To enable efficient calibration, we show that attention-output error strongly correlates with end-to-end video quality and can therefore serve as a lightweight proxy for allocation risk assessment. We evaluate different allocation strategies using this proxy and construct a fixed layer-head risk map offline. Given a cache budget at inference time, CALM uses dynamic programming to determine the best allocation of merging ratios. Experiments across three different autoregressive video models demonstrate that CALM consistently outperforms uniform token merging under the same memory budget, by reducing the LPIPS to original videos by around 21% with higher video-quality scores.

papers.title_en: Different Tasks, Different Timesteps: Temporal Task-Aware Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
papers.authors: Ofek Avivi, Eliron Rahimi, Avi Mendelson, Chaim Baskin
papers.evidence: 任务与时间步相关的量化敏感度及无标签混合精度分配
papers.tldr: 扩散语言模型因迭代去噪过程面临独特量化挑战，且量化敏感度同时依赖下游任务与去噪时间步，不同任务在各步骤的精度需求并不一致。T2Quant 利用无需真实标签或任务指标的敏感度信号，在固定比特预算下为不同时间步分配激活精度，实现任务与时间感知的混合精度量化。在三个DLM和六个基准上，它持续提升现有量化方法的平均准确率，同等预算最高增益6.7个百分点，为DLM高效部署提供新方案。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) introduce unique quantization challenges due to their iterative denoising process. In this work, we reveal that quantization sensitivity is both taskand time-dependent, with different downstream tasks exhibiting distinct precision requirements across denoising steps. We further show that these patterns can be predicted without groundtruth labels or task-specific evaluation metrics. Building on these findings, we introduce T 2Quant, a task and time-aware mixedprecision quantization framework that uses a label-free sensitivity signal to optimally allocate activation precision across denoising steps under a fixed bit-width budget. Extensive experiments across three DLMs and six benchmarks demonstrate that T 2Quant consistently improves the average accuracy of existing quantization methods, achieving gains of up to 6.7 percentage points under the same budget.
